author: The Infographics Show
description:
For the first time in history, humanity isn’t just planning to visit another world, it’s preparing to live there.

From ice hidden in eternal darkness to solar-powered peaks and 3D-printed habitats, NASA’s Artemis program is laying the groundwork for a permanent lunar presence.
The Moon is no longer just a destination, it’s becoming a launchpad, a resource hub, and potentially the first off-world city.

This breakdown of how NASA will build a city on the Moon explores the technology, the strategy, and the challenges of turning a hostile wasteland into a functioning human settlement.

The next giant leap isn’t a footprint, it’s civilization.

CHAPTERS:
0:00 - NASA’s Plan to Build a Moon City
0:50 - Why NASA Is Targeting the South Pole
3:34 - The Water Ice That Changes Everything
8:20 - The Moon Dust Problem
11:06 - NASA’s Plan to Start Building
12:16 - 3D-Printing the Moon Base
18:19 - Powering a Permanent Lunar Outpost
21:56 - Who Will Actually Live There?

Narrated by: Josh Risser
title: This is How NASA Will Build a City on the Moon
